label: Russell Targ
narrative: Targ was Puthoff's co-principal investigator at SRI from 1972 to 1982, a laser physicist by training who co-authored the 1974 Nature paper and the 1978 remote-viewing protocol document that survives in the declassified STARGATE corpus. He is included here because he is the corroborating half of the SRI record: two named scientists, one private research institute, a decade of federal intelligence funding, and a paper trail that CIA itself released. Targ has been consistently more willing than most participants to describe the funding chain in plain terms - CIA first, then Army INSCOM, then DIA - and his account of the programme's institutional history is the least embellished available from a principal. He left SRI in 1982 for Lockheed Missiles and Space Company, a transition that itself illustrates the porousness between the FFRDC/contract research world and the defence primes that this board tracks.
